notes.title: 2025 Update
notes.notes:
[p][b]Trials of Cascadia Development Update[/b][/p][p]It’s been a while since the last update, and I have been buried in development, so I wanted to share what I’ve been working on and where things are at.[/p][p]I’m aiming for a Q3 2026 release, but that will depend on when the game actually feels finished. I started Trials of Cascadia back in mid 2021, and I’ve put over 10,000 hours into it (so far). I really want the final game to reflect all the time and care that’s gone into it, and for it to be playable all at once.[/p][p] [/p][previewyoutube="18EJoUT4Dkg;full"][/previewyoutube][p][b]

What's New?[/b][/p][p][b]
[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43210507/1eb6ee1702978bd5ed64f07a11967e71525ceefa.png"][/img][b]
Subclasses:[/b] Each of the main characters will have a choice between two subclasses unique to them once reaching a certain level, and they can switch freely at any town or hub.[/p][p][b]Talent Trees and Passive Perks:[/b] Every character now has their own talent tree and passive perks learned via experience. I wanted to give as much agency over builds as I could for characters with role-based skills. [/p][p][b]Chain Gauge:[/b] This builds up stars during battle and can trigger duplicate attacks or rare bonus effects, like buffs or healing.[/p][p][b]Cascade Gauge and Stagger System:[/b] Repeatedly hitting enemies pushes them through damage tiers (2x, 3x, 4x), opening up big windows for team combos and strategy.[/p][p][b]Reactive Elements:[/b] Combine different elements on enemies to trigger new effects like Steam Explosion or Molten Rock. This adds a lot of depth and encourages experimenting with spells.[/p][p][b]Assist Attacks:[/b] If two party members have matching [b]TP[/b], you can trigger bonus follow up attacks after actions.[/p][p][b]Spell Priming:[/b] Hold down the action button while casting a spell to consume extra [b]Pwr[/b] and boost its damage.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43210507/0d7093f0bd4baa8d4d83918eb3a377d52f6ab9f2.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Weapon and Armor Rarity Tiers:[/b] There are now Epic, Legendary, and other rare gear types, each with unique stats and effects.[/p][p][b]Gem Socketing:[/b] You can slot gems into weapons and armor for extra stats, utility, or elemental bonuses.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Dynamic Battle Camera:[/b] Battles now have more movement and focus, making turn-based combat feel livelier.[/p][p][b]Full Voice Acting:[/b] All 30,000+ words of story and battle lines are fully voiced by over 20 professional actors to bring characters to life.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Content & World[/b][/p][p][b]350+ Maps:[/b] Cascadia is huge, with tons of regions, towns, dungeons, and secrets to find.[/p][p][b]40+ Hidden Minigames:[/b] There are lots of optional minigames scattered throughout the world for extra challenges and rewards.


[b]Where Things Stand[/b][/p][p]The game is about 80 to 85 percent done. What’s left is:[/p][list][*][p]Writing and finishing the endgame story[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Stitching everything together into a smooth, complete experience[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Importing all the voice lines and audio into the final scenes[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Balancing combat and finalizing character and enemy data[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Bug testing, polish, and quality control[/p][/*][/list][p]I’m working a full-time job alongside this but still spend an average of 5 hours a night on the game. I’ve jumped around different parts of the project to keep things fresh, so now it’s mostly about filling in the gaps and tying everything together.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks so much for following along and sticking with me. There’s more to come![/p]

notes.title: June 2024 Update
notes.notes:
Welcome back for June's update! Things are only heating up outside, and it's the same thing for the development of ToC! Besides continuing to work on the main story, and a bunch of small updates and bug fixes, we've been able to accomplish a lot of feature implementations as well. Let's take a quick look:


[b]BATTLE CAMERA[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43210507/932056f224ef5facdd1e3f52782b0fe94f28c459.gif[/img]

I always liked the rotating battles from Golden Sun, so we've added a new panning camera for combat to feel more immersive. This also comes with an update to all background art for a more pronounced 3D effect. 


[b]CHAIN METER[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43210507/22134cc9240f2f43a1bcae81d425476ddba84b3c.gif[/img]
 
The Chain Meter is a new mechanic, where for each point of damage done by the party, it will continue to increase both the party's overall ATB speed, as well as a chance to duplicate any damage (at least until someone in the party loses health). This encourages you to cleanse those poisons and burns, and interrupt spells so that you can unleash a ton of bonus attacks with a high meter.


[b]GEM SOCKETING[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43210507/1d5ba7d06a3572de383d2bd25161e772a7d06aa3.gif[/img]

We've introduced gem socketing as a mechanic to customize your weapons and armor. Before, gems would drop from the random elemental shades out in the world, but they didn't have much use beyond a relatively weak spell or being sold to the vendor for a moderate amount of gold. Now, you are able to speak with any blacksmith to add gems to weapons, armor, and some accessories, granting them bonus stats depending on the color and grade.


[b]MYSTERY BOX[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43210507/8e6b1d30b4b1fd902155c184b43f194d6f62c70b.gif[/img]

You won't be able to find grade 2 'cut' gems, grade 3 'lux' gems, or grade 4 legendary gems out in the wild. Instead, blacksmiths can combine five of any color gem (for a small fee) in order to create a single higher rank gem. You can also trade in random junk items from monsters to the blacksmith to get a Mystery Box, which also has a chance to contain higher grade gems. Just be warned that when you socket a gem, you cannot remove it... only replace.


[b]Stay tuned for July's update around this time of the month![/b]
